p: Sin: This is the eighth place in which they had camped, there is another place called Zin, which was the 33rd place in which they camped, and is also called Kadesh, Nu 33:36.
pots: It is a hard thing for the flesh not to complain against God when the stomach is empty.
day: To signify that they should patiently depend on God's providence from day to day.
for that he heareth your murmurings: He did not give them Manna because they complained, but because of his promise.
LORD: He that condemns God's ministers, condemns God himself.
manna: Which signifies a part, portion, or gift: also meat prepared.
an omer for every man: Which contains about half a gallon in our measure.
lack: God richly feeds everyone, and no one can justly complain.
stank: No creature is so pure, but being abused it turns to our destruction.
twice as much bread: Which would serve for the Sabbath and the day before.
find it in the field: God took away the opportunity for their labour, to signify how holy he would have the Sabbath kept.
went out some of the people: Their unfaithfulness was so great, that they did exactly the opposite of God's commandment.
coriander seed: In form and figure, but not in colour; Nu 11:7.
pot: Of this vessel read He 9:4.
Testimony: That is, the Ark of the covenant that is, after the Ark was made.
ephah: Which measure contained about five gallons.
